newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazil's CBD started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazil's CBD started.

text.p: -- UBS Securities said it started Braziian retailer Companhia Brasileira de Distribuicao with a hold rating.
-- "While we like CBD as an operator, we find the valuation is not currently compelling," analysts Julio Zamora and John McCormack wrote in a report.

-- "Located in the fastest-growing market in the region, CBD trades at a 38 percent discount in estimated 1997 price/earnings to its peers in Latin America, but a much smaller discount in other measures, like price to EBITDA and EV/EBITDA.
-- "Our 12-month price target is $21.60, based on a multiple of 12 times projected 1997 earnings."
-- The company's preferred shares closed at 17.15 reais on the Sao Paulo exchange on Monday.
